verdict.rationale: Zep's pricing page lists 'Your VPC' next to Cloud under 'Deploy anywhere', which is a first-party option to run the core product in the customer's own environment. Nothing documents how that deployment works or who can get it, and the quick start points to the cloud SDK (zep-cloud). The open-source Graphiti framework runs locally, but it is the underlying graph engine rather than the full Zep platform, so it adds little credit here. Missing for 10: self-hosting/VPC deployment docs, installation or packaging details for the core platform, availability terms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted Zep.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework. Use it to build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally
